tasks.label: Karacter AI: verify
tasks.command: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

tasks.label: KAI precommit safety audit
tasks.command:
printf '%s
' '--- status ---' && git status --short && printf '%s
' '--- staged names ---' && git diff --cached --name-only && printf '%s
' '--- unstaged names ---' && git diff --name-only && printf '%s
' '--- tracked environment files ---' && git ls-files -- .env .env.local .env.example && printf '%s
' '--- ignore rules ---' && (git check-ignore -v .env .env.local || true) && printf '%s
' '--- current branch ---' && git branch --show-current && printf '%s
' '--- remotes ---' && git remote
